title: Per-item cost attributes an Agent-tool subagent's usage to the item it worked, as the sprint total does
goal: From the SP-matmvkn6 close retrospective: with the orchestrator's session open, backlog.py cost --rework SP-matmvkn6 showed 11.4M attributed (sub) tokens, while each story and bug of the sprint showed attributed (sub) 0, though Agent-tool subagents in work/<id> worktrees did each item's work. Premise: rerun the per-item costs once the session has closed; if per-item sub stays 0, each item's figure includes the subagent usage of its own worktree.
